error.catalog_changed: The catalog changed since this strategy was computed, so its prices and cut plans can no longer be shown as they were. Generate again to price it against today's catalog.
error.catalog_schema_changed: This strategy was generated before the catalog gained new product fields, so its prices and cut plans can no longer be read as they were. Nothing was repriced — the catalog's shape changed. Generate again.
error.clear_gap_exceeded: No strategy was generated: a gap of {value_mm} {u} in section {run_id} exceeds the hard limit of {limit_mm} {u}.
error.contract_major_unsupported: This snapshot was built against a contract version this engine does not speak. Refused at load rather than at generate.
error.contract_minor_predates_typed_date: This snapshot predates the typed Date the contract now requires, so its dates cannot be read. It needs re-cutting by the Knowledge Platform — normalising the dates here would invent facts the sources do not state.
error.decision_ref_needs_run: A decision is numbered per generation, so asking for {decision_ref} without saying which run it belongs to would mix comments about different decisions. Ask for one run's conversation, or for the whole project's.
error.fence_model_invalid: No strategy was generated: fence model {model_ref} cannot be used ({n} problem(s)). {errors}
error.fence_model_not_a_draft: {model_ref} is {status}, not a draft — a published version cannot be discarded, because a stored run or an accepted quote may name it
error.fence_model_not_found: No strategy was generated: fence model {model_id} is not available — it does not exist, or no version of it is published. Choose another model for this project or section.
error.fence_model_reserved: {model_id} is the built-in compatibility model and cannot be edited — its products follow your knowledge rules. Duplicate it under a new id to build on it.
error.fence_model_unknown_sku: No strategy was generated: the catalog has no product called {skus}. Fix the SKU in the knowledge rule that selects it, then generate again.
error.member_run_unreadable: This run's continuous rails point at bays that are no longer in it, so its structure cannot be read — press the Generate strategy button to compute it again.
error.model_changed: These assembly steps belong to {model_ref}, and this panel was built to {panel_model_ref}. A step names slots, so laying one version's instructions over another version's panel would describe a panel nobody built.
error.no_item_covers_part_spec: No product in the catalogue covers the {role} specification of model {model} at station {station_mm}. A fence cannot be built without a post there: add a product that meets the specification, or change the model's {slot_key} slot.
error.pattern_residual_large: No strategy was generated: section {run_id} leaves {value_mm} {u} of the pattern unfilled, over the hard tolerance of {limit_mm} {u}.
error.post_routing_mismatch: The panel at station {station_mm} puts its rails at {wanted}, and the posts of model {model} are routed at {routed}. The holes are punched at the factory, so this fence cannot be assembled — change the height, the rail count, or the post product.
error.post_spec_conflict: The bays either side of station {station_mm} are built to different models ({models}), and no post in the catalogue satisfies both specifications. Both apply to the one post that stands between them, so either the models must agree or the boundary must move.
error.rail_separation_insufficient: No strategy was generated: the rail spacing in section {run_id} ({value_mm} {u}) is under the hard anti-climb limit of {limit_mm} {u}.
error.run_predates_fence_model: This run was computed before fence models existed, so its structure cannot be read — press ⚙ Generate strategy to compute it again.
error.site_conditions_changed: The site conditions changed after this run was generated, so this document would describe a different fence. Generate again to see it.
error.sku_not_eligible: {sku} is not one of the products the {slot_key} slot of this panel can be built from, so the panel was not priced with it. Choose one of the products offered for that part.
error.slot_not_purchasable: {slot_key} is a part that comes inside another part, so no product is bought for it separately — it arrives with whatever supplies the part that contains it.
error.snapshot_id_mismatch: This document's contents do not hash to the snapshot id it declares, so it is not the snapshot that id names. Fetch it again.
error.snapshot_malformed: This document does not parse as a Snapshot. The specific fields are listed below, for whoever is holding the document.
error.topology_changed: The drawing changed since this strategy was computed. Generate again to lay it out over the fence as it is now.
error.unresolved_supply: This strategy has {n} part(s) no product can supply, so it cannot be frozen into a quote that would under-price the job.

warning.clear_gap_exceeded: A gap of {value_mm} {u} in section {run_id} exceeds the {limit_mm} {u} limit ({n} bay(s)) — narrow the spacing or widen the members
warning.contained_credit_surplus: {contained} brings {qty} more than the {slot} of this panel needs in {n} bay(s) — the extra pieces arrive in the box and cover nothing, so only what was needed came off the order
warning.contained_credit_unmatched: {contained} is meant to supply the {slot} of this panel, but model {model_ref} does not build a {slot} in {n} bay(s) — those pieces arrive in the box and cover nothing, so nothing was taken off the order
warning.continuity_override_disagrees: {slot} in section {run_id} is set to continuity “{authored}”, but {stock_length_mm} {u} stock across a {span_mm} {u} bay works out at {derived_bays} bay(s) per piece — the setting wins and it is built at {built_bays} bay(s) per piece
warning.continuity_override_unbuildable: {slot} in section {run_id} is set to run through its posts, but {stock_length_mm} {u} stock cannot reach past the first {span_mm} {u} bay — it is cut bay by bay
warning.continuity_stock_length_unknown: {slot} in section {run_id} is detailed to run through its posts, but no product for it states a stock length — so nothing bounds how far one piece reaches. It is built at {built_bays} bay(s) per piece.
warning.declined_max_span: {param} for {model_ref} came from a source this run declined to trust; {n} bay(s) laid out to {value_mm} {u}, no wider than that source stated
warning.exact_span_over_max: Model {model_ref} is made in {exact_mm} {u} bays, wider than the {max_mm} {u} maximum span — section {run_id} was laid out freely instead
warning.excessive_gap: Stepped span {element} leaves a {gap_mm} {u} gap underneath (limit {max_mm} {u})
warning.excessive_step: Step of {step_mm} {u} at {element} exceeds the buildable maximum ({max_mm} {u}) — needs an engineered solution
warning.gate_kit_width_mismatch: Gate kit {sku} fits a {kit_width_mm} {u} opening but {element} is {opening_width_mm} {u} — the wrong gate would be priced
warning.gate_on_slope: Gate {element} sits on a slope of {slope_permille}‰ (limit {max_permille}‰) — level the ground for the gate to swing
warning.gate_past_run_end: Gate at station {station_mm} {u} asks for {asked_mm} {u} but only {available_mm} {u} of the section remains — move it or shorten it.
warning.height_not_supported: Fence model {model_ref} is not made in {n} of the panel heights in section {run_id} (from {min_mm} {u} to {max_mm} {u}) — change the height or choose another model
warning.insufficient_post_length: Post {element} needs {required_mm} {u} but {sku} is only {available_mm} {u} long — choose a longer post
warning.knowledge_conflict: Conflicting knowledge for {slot}: {contenders} — the highest-priority version wins.
warning.max_height_exceeded: {element} reaches {height_mm} {u} plumb height at the downhill end — above the {max_mm} {u} limit
warning.no_default_post: No rule names a default ground-post product; {n} post(s) have no product and are unfilled in the bill of materials
warning.no_eligible_item: Nothing is eligible to supply the {role}{slot} at {pegs} — the fence model names no product for it.
warning.no_feasible_item: No product can supply the {role}{slot} at {pegs}: none of {skus} fits the piece it needs.
warning.no_gate_kit: No catalog product fits the {opening_width_mm} {u} opening of {element} — this gate cannot be priced
warning.no_item_covers_part_spec: No product in the catalogue covers the cap specification of {model} at station {station_mm} — the post there is uncapped
warning.no_item_covers_post_spec: No product in the catalogue covers the post specification of {model} — this bay is drawn at its centre-to-centre width rather than the opening between two posts
warning.node_surface_disagreement: Runs meeting at node {node_id} disagree on base surface ({surfaces}); using {chosen}.
warning.orphaned_override: Override {override_id} ({directive}) no longer matches the topology and was not applied.
warning.panel_length_unresolved: Model {model_ref} cannot work out a cut length for {slot} in {n} bay(s) of section {run_id} — the frame members it is measured between leave nothing to measure, so the part would be priced at nothing
warning.parameter_authority_lapsed: The {authority} row for {parameter} was valid until {valid_until}, before this run's date {as_of}
warning.parameter_condition_excluded: {parameter} does not extend to {point} — the source explicitly excludes this range, it is not merely uncovered
warning.parameter_hit_policy_unsupported: The published {parameter} table resolves by {hit_policy}, which this engine cannot yet honour — the table was not applied
warning.parameter_not_yet_in_force: The {authority} row for {parameter} is not in force until {valid_from}, after this run's date {as_of}
warning.parameter_paired_unsupported: The published {parameter} table offers {alternatives} design points per condition ({value_type}); this engine cannot yet choose between them, so the table was not applied
warning.parameter_rows_overlap: Rows {row} and {other_row} of {parameter} both cover {point}, but the table declares its conditions disjoint — no value was chosen
warning.parameter_scope_unmappable: A published {parameter} table is scoped to a {entity_kind}, which this engine cannot aim at — the table was not applied
warning.parameter_task_unrecognised: A published {parameter} table decides {task}, which this engine has no source policy for — its rows were used without their sources being judged
warning.parameter_value_nonconforming: A published {parameter} row does not match the table's declared type ({value_type}) and was not used
warning.pattern_residual_large: Section {run_id} leaves {value_mm} {u} of the pattern unfilled, over the {limit_mm} {u} tolerance ({n} bay(s))
warning.published_spec_unapplied: {part} publishes {parameter}, and this run judged the source good enough to use it — but no product in this catalog claims to be that part, so the value reaches no line
warning.rail_separation_insufficient: In section {run_id} the rail above the bottom one is only {value_mm} {u} up, under the {limit_mm} {u} anti-climb limit ({n} bay(s))
warning.site_condition_missing: {n} site condition(s) that decide how this fence is built are not set ({dimensions}) — the rules and fence-model options that depend on them did not apply
warning.source_below_min_curation: {parameter} came from a source at curation level {curation_level}, below the bar for {task} — nobody has checked it against the page, so the published value was not used
warning.source_class_unrecognised: A published {parameter} row cites a {source_class}, a source class this engine has no policy row for — the row was used without its source being judged
warning.source_inadmissible: {parameter} came from a {source_class}, which is not admissible for {task} — the published value was not used
warning.source_ref_missing: A published {parameter} row from a {source_class} carries no source reference, so the number cannot be traced to a document
warning.span_not_exact: Section {run_id} does not divide into {exact_mm} {u} bays: {remainder_mm} {u} is left over as an odd bay — model {model_ref} is made in one size
warning.span_placed_over_maximum: In section {run_id}, {author} placed a bay {placed_mm} {u} wide — {over_mm} {u} over the {max_mm} {u} maximum. It is built as placed
warning.substitute_needs_approval: {sku} is a suggested substitute for the {role}{slot} at {pegs} and needs approval before it can be used
warning.tilted_stepped: Section {run_id} combines tilted posts ({mode}) with stepped panels — stepped panels normally pair with plumb posts; check the design
warning.uncovered_max_span: No rule states the maximum span for {model_ref} in section {run_id}; {n} bay(s) laid out to {value_mm} {u} — confirm before ordering
warning.uncovered_parameter_point: {parameter} has no published value for {point} — confirm before ordering
warning.uncovered_rails_per_span: No rule states how many rails a bay of {model_ref} gets in section {run_id}; {n} bay(s) built with {value} rails each — confirm before ordering
warning.uncovered_screws_per_span: No rule states how many screws a bay of {model_ref} gets in section {run_id}; {n} bay(s) built with {value} screws each — confirm before ordering
warning.unknown_product: Gate kit '{sku}' is not in the catalog; BOM will price it at zero.
